title: Require external anchor evidence on high-autonomy work
narrative: High-autonomy graphs must periodically attach labeled external anchors so branches cannot drift on mutually reinforcing model judgments alone. Accepts WalkingLabs L14 guidance[^wl-l14-anchor].
implementation: `AnchorRequirement`, `AnchorEvidence`, and `anchors_satisfied` in `mechaharness.anchor_evidence` label and require anchor kinds.
